name: Imy Khan
title: Researcher in Artificial Life & Artificial Intelligence
bio: Independent researcher working in artificial life, 4E cognition (particularly socio-affective cognition), artificial intelligence, affective computing, human-robot interaction, and adaptive systems/cybernetics. Teaching Fellow at the University of Warwick, Honorary Research Fellow in Psychology at Warwick, Affiliated Researcher at DICE Lab (University of Gothenburg), and Visiting Lecturer at the University of Hertfordshire.
